stories.h: Coastal flood warnings, gusty winds hit Washington coast today
stories.s: Coastal flood warnings run through midday Tuesday for Grays Harbor, the North Coast and the Strait, with advisories for Seattle and Puget Sound and beach gusts to 45 mph. A Mason County flood watch starts Wednesday.

stories.h: Utilities brace for wind-driven outages before Thanksgiving
stories.s: Puget Sound Energy and Seattle City Light have crews on standby around the clock, warning that saturated soil and gusty winds make trees more likely to fall into lines.

stories.h: Winter storm watch for North Cascades through Thursday
stories.s: NWS Seattle expects 4–8 inches of snow in the Whatcom and Skagit Cascades by Tuesday night, then possibly 5–15 inches of heavy wet snow above 5,000 feet late Wednesday into Thursday, with 35 mph gusts and hard travel.

stories.h: Manhunt in Stevens County for man accused of firing at deputies
stories.s: US Marshals are hunting Ronald Rutledge, 45, accused of shooting a rifle at deputies near Waitts Lake and fleeing in a stolen white Polaris Ranger. He's considered armed and dangerous; call 911, don't approach.

stories.h: Washington bids for U.S. Space Academy in Federal Way
stories.s: The state formally applied to host the national Space Academy, starting temporarily at UW with a permanent campus at Federal Way's Woodbridge Corporate Park by 2031. No decision date is set.

stories.h: SpaceX fights state fine over lead at Redmond Starlink site
stories.s: SpaceX is appealing a $6,000 Labor & Industries fine after inspectors found lead 18 times the limit on a workbench; another violation involved heating a part in a breakroom toaster oven.

talking.h: Sam Darnold returns to Seahawks practice before 49ers
talking.s: Darnold practiced Monday for the first time in three weeks after quad and rib injuries and is expected to start at San Francisco; Charles Cross and Leonard Williams also returned for the 6-4 Seahawks.

talking.h: Kakko's late goal lifts Kraken past Ducks 3-2
talking.s: All five goals came in the third period; Kaapo Kakko won it with 2:25 left at Climate Pledge Arena, moving the Kraken to 11-9-1.

coming.h: Inland king tides peak; coastal flood watch Wed–Thu
coming.s: Puget Sound tides peak Wednesday, with flood watches for Hood Canal, east Kitsap and Port Townsend Wednesday and Thursday; Mason County's flood watch runs through Sunday.

coming.h: Ferry crunch: Port Townsend cancellations, Vashon tidal limits
coming.s: Over 300,000 riders are expected Nov. 25–29. An evening Port Townsend–Coupeville round trip is cut daily through Friday, and Vashon routes restrict low-clearance vehicles through Sunday.

coming.h: I-90 Snoqualmie Pass worst eastbound Wednesday afternoon
coming.s: WSDOT expects eastbound I-90 heaviest Wednesday roughly 11 a.m.–4 p.m., peaking near 3 p.m.; westbound peaks around 2 p.m. Friday through Sunday.

coming.h: Thanksgiving tolls: I-405, SR 167 lanes free
coming.s: Express toll lanes on I-405 and SR 167 are free Thursday; SR 520, the SR 99 tunnel and SR 509 use weekend rates. Chinook and Cayuse passes are closed for the season.

coming.h: Huskies visit Oregon in rivalry game at Autzen
coming.s: Washington plays at Oregon in Eugene Saturday, a week after upsetting Indiana in overtime.

coming.h: Seahawks at 49ers in NFC West showdown
coming.s: The 6-4 Seahawks visit the division-leading 9-1 49ers at Levi's Stadium.
